selection_basis: Conservative exact spans read from extracted paragraphs. No PHM site-specific outcomes, example trajectories, performance tables, inferred sensor mappings, references, equations or model-training sections. External HVAC examples remain identified as external examples.
chunking_decision: Reviewed passages use deterministic source-preserving sentence boundaries. Earlier Qwen pilot remains separate; these chunks are not represented as Qwen-generated.
excluded_material: All unlisted spans remain excluded from this index. Overlapping general APAR mode descriptions retained only from source 03; source 04 contributes distinct operational limitations and a field counterexample.
